title: Completed inverse-purity comparison is the counit mate
statement: Let $k_0$ be a finite field of characteristic $p$, let $k$ be its fixed algebraic closure, and fix a prime $\ell\ne p$ and a finite coefficient extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, with ring of integers $\mathcal O_E$, as in [def-pur-conventions]. Let $X_0,Y_0$ be separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes, $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ a separated finite-type morphism, and $X,Y,f$ their geometric base changes. Suppose $f$ is smooth of pure relative dimension $d\ge0$. Fix a compactification $c_0$ of $f_0$ and the specified exceptional coefficient system $S$, with the actual comparisons of [def-pur-weil-equivariance-data]. Put $P=Lg_Y^*$, $Q=Lg_X^*$, $H=Lf^*(-)(d)[2d]$, and $F\dashv G$ is the specified completed integral constructible adjunction. Write $\Gamma_K:HK\simeq GK$ for integralGamma, $b_K:QHK\simeq HPK$ for integralB, and $B_M:PFM\simeq FQM$ for integralBeta, all the fixed canonical maps. For every completed integral finite-Tor object $K$ on $Y$ one has $F((Q\Gamma_K)^{-1}b_K\Gamma_{PK})\,\varepsilon_{PK}=B_{GK}^{-1}P(\varepsilon_K)$. Composition is diagrammatic. This identifies the exceptional comparison before choosing a strict Weil datum and makes no assertion about a transported trace square.

proof.text: On the entire normalized reduction tower of K apply [lem-pur-tower-geometric-purity-mate]. The inverse-purity composite is the right counit mate of inverse support exchange. The adjunct-counit identity [lem-weil-pbc-adjunct-counit-identity] says that applying support to this mate and then the counit returns inverse support exchange followed by the pulled-back counit.

proof.text: Apply total derived inverse limit using the normalized reconstruction units of [det-sp-normalized-equivalence]. The source, root-line, pullback, support and exceptional transpose comparisons of [lem-pur-integral-geometric-comparison-realization] identify the realized equation with its completed integral counterpart. Use [lem-pur-tower-trace-purity-comparison] to identify its purity with the actual trace-transpose integralGamma. Conjugation by the specified left-functor comparison and the unique counit-preserving right-adjoint comparison gives exactly integralB, integralBeta, and the specified counit of [def-pur-weil-equivariance-data]. All equalities are realized whole-tower equalities.

lean.statement:
theorem integralEquivariance_mate
    (K : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory P.coefficients.l P.extension
      (P.frobeniusFiber Y₀).left) :
    (S.ring.operation (zlGeometricCompactification P.field f₀ c₀)
        (.integral (AdicSmoothDualizing.fieldStage P))).F.map
      (((integralP P X₀).mapIso (integralGamma P X₀ Y₀ f₀ d c₀ S K)).inv ≫
        (integralB P X₀ Y₀ f₀ d K).hom ≫
        (integralGamma P X₀ Y₀ f₀ d c₀ S ((integralP P Y₀).obj K)).hom) ≫
      (S.ring.operation (zlGeometricCompactification P.field f₀ c₀)
        (.integral (AdicSmoothDualizing.fieldStage P))).adjunction.counit.app
          ((integralP P Y₀).obj K) =
    (integralBeta P X₀ Y₀ f₀ c₀ S
      ((S.ring.operation (zlGeometricCompactification P.field f₀ c₀)
        (.integral (AdicSmoothDualizing.fieldStage P))).G.obj K)).inv ≫
      (integralP P Y₀).map
        ((S.ring.operation (zlGeometricCompactification P.field f₀ c₀)
          (.integral (AdicSmoothDualizing.fieldStage P))).adjunction.counit.app K)
